Tests use node:test. Do not use the Fable model. 4 5 Build a meeting-room booking app: an HTTP server `server.mjs` (an ES module, run as `node server.mjs`) that serves a JSON API and a browser page, and keeps its data in one JSON file. 6 7 ## Server 8 - At startup the server checks `PORT`, then reads the data file, then starts listening, in that order. 9 - It listens on 127.0.0.1 at the port in the `PORT` environment variable. An unset or empty `PORT` means 3000. A `PORT` that is not made only of ASCII digits 0-9, or whose value is above 65535, or a port that cannot be bound (for example because it is in use), makes the server write one line of its choice to stderr and exit with code 1. 10 - Once listening, it prints `listening on http://127.0.0.1:` followed by "\n" to stdout, where `` is the port actually bound (with `PORT=0`, the port the OS picked). This line is the only thing the server ever writes to stdout. 11 - Its data lives in the file named by the `DATA_FILE` environment variable, as JSON in a layout of your choice. An unset or empty `DATA_FILE` means `bookings.json`. A relative `DATA_FILE`, the default included, is resolved against the current working directory, not the folder of `server.mjs`. 12 - The server reads the data file once, at startup. If reading it fails with `ENOENT` (the file, or a folder on its path, does not exist), there are no bookings yet. If reading it fails in any other way (for example the path is a directory), or its content is not data in the layout this server writes (for example it is empty or not valid JSON), the server writes `cannot read data file ` followed by "\n" to stderr, where `` is the value of `DATA_FILE` as given (`bookings.json` when it is unset or empty), and exits with code 1 without listening. 13 - After startup the server's memory is the truth: changes made to the file from outside are not noticed. The server writes the data file only when a POST creates a booking or a DELETE removes one, never at startup or for any other request, and it never creates folders. 14 - Every change is saved to the data file before its reply is sent: after a restart with the same `DATA_FILE`, the bookings, and the id the next booking will get, are as before. 15 - If saving a change fails (for example because the data file's folder does not exist), the reply is 500 `internal error` and nothing changes, the next id included. Any other unexpected failure while handling a request also replies 500 `internal error`. In both cases the server keeps running. 16 - Requests that arrive at the same time give the same result as if they had been handled one at a time in some order: of several overlapping bookings sent at once while saving works, exactly one is created and every other one gets 409, and no id is given twice. 17 - Before sending any reply, the server reads the whole request body, if there is one, and discards what it does not use, so the client always receives the reply, the 413 and 415 replies included. 18 19 ## API 20 - The rooms are fixed: `Aurora`, `Borealis` and `Cosmos`, in that order. 21 - A booking is a JSON object with exactly the keys `id`, `room`, `title`, `date`, `start` and `end`: `id` is a number, the others are strings. The first booking gets id 1 and each new booking the next integer; an id is never reused, even after deletes and restarts. 22 - Only the parsed JSON of a reply body matters: whitespace and key order in it are free. 23 - A request's path is its request target up to the first `?` (all of it when there is no `?`). Routes compare the path byte for byte, with no percent-decoding and no dot-segment, slash or letter-case normalisation: `/api/%62ookings`, `/api/./rooms`, `/API/rooms` and `/api/bookings/` are none of the paths below. The query, the text after the first `?`, is ignored unless stated, and is decoded as `new URLSearchParams(query)` does. 24 - `GET /api/rooms`: 200 `{"rooms": ["Aurora", "Borealis", "Cosmos"]}`. 25 - `GET /api/bookings`: 200 `{"bookings": [...]}` with every booking, sorted by date, then start, then room in the order above. When the query has a `date` parameter (as `params.has('date')` says; `?date` with no `=` counts, with the empty value), its value is `params.get('date')` (the first one when repeated) and the reply holds only the bookings on that date; a value that is not a valid date by rule 6 below (the empty value included) gets 400 `date must be a valid YYYY-MM-DD date`. Other query parameters are ignored. 26 - `POST /api/bookings` with a JSON body holding `room`, `title`, `date`, `start` and `end`: 201 and the new booking. Other keys in the body are ignored. 27 - `DELETE /api/bookings/`: every path that is `/api/bookings/` followed by a non-empty `` holding no `/` is this route, whatever `` is. The reply is 204 with an empty body, and the booking is gone. When `` is not a positive integer written in ASCII digits 0-9 without a leading zero, or no booking has that id: 404 `booking not found`. 28 - `GET /` and `GET /app.js` serve the page (see Page). 29 - Any other path: 404 `not found`, whatever the method. This includes every path that starts with `/api/bookings/` and whose rest is empty or holds a `/`, such as `/api/bookings/` and `/api/bookings/1/`. 30 - A path above with a method not listed for it (HEAD and OPTIONS included): 405 `method not allowed`. For example `GET /api/bookings/abc` is 405. A 405 reply may or may not have an `Allow` header; it is not checked. 31 - Every reply with a body other than the page and the script has `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`. An error reply is `{"error": ""}` with exactly that key, where `` is the text given here. 32 33 ## Booking rules (`POST /api/bookings`; the first rule that fails decides the reply) 34 1. The media type of the `Content-Type` header (the part before the first `;`, with spaces and tabs removed from both ends, letter case ignored) is not `application/json`, or the header is missing: 415 `content type must be application/json`. 35 2. The body is longer than 10000 bytes, counting the body bytes actually received: 413 `body too large`. 36 3. The body, decoded as `Buffer.prototype.toString('utf8')` does and then given to `JSON.parse`, is not a JSON object (it is empty, not valid JSON, `null`, an array, a string, a number or a boolean): 400 `body must be a JSON object`. Bytes that are not valid UTF-8 become U+FFFD and are not an error by themselves. A byte order mark at the very start is kept, so such a body is not valid JSON. 37 4. `room` is not a string equal to one of the room names (letter case matters): 400 `room must be one of Aurora, Borealis, Cosmos`. 38 5. `title` is not a string, or is shorter than 1 or longer than 80 UTF-16 code units after removing the whitespace at both ends (as `String.prototype.trim` does): 400 `title must be 1 to 80 characters`. The booking keeps the trimmed title. 39 6. `date` is not a string `YYYY-MM-DD` (4, 2 and 2 ASCII digits 0-9) naming a real day from 2000-01-01 to 2099-12-31, where February has 29 days in years divisible by 4: 400 `date must be a valid YYYY-MM-DD date`. 40 7. `start` is not a string `HH:MM` (2 and 2 ASCII digits 0-9) from `00:00` to `23:59`: 400 `start must be HH:MM`. 41 8. `end` is not such a string: 400 `end must be HH:MM`. 42 9. `end` is not later than `start`: 400 `end must be after start`. 43 10. The booking overlaps a booking of the same room on the same date, that is each of the two starts before the other ends (a booking may start exactly when another ends): 409 `room is already booked from to `, with the start and end of the overlapping booking that starts earliest. 44 - No field except `title` is trimmed or changed: ` 2026-11-03`, `2026-11-3` and `9:00` are invalid. 45 46 ## Page 47 - `GET /` answers 200 with `Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8` and the page. `GET /app.js` answers 200 with `Content-Type: text/javascript; charset=utf-8` and the page's script. 48 - The page loads the script with a `

content.text:
## Review: node:test suite for the booking app

**Evidence I checked:** `npm test` passes 390 tests in 4.7 s. I ran near-misses 1, 7, 22 and 35 (overlap `<=`, title `< 80`, list-fetch race, missing "No bookings.") and all four were killed; the unmodified scratch copy exits 0. No `console.log`, `.only` or TODO in `test/`. Every file is 400 lines or fewer and every function is under 50 lines (`runScenario` is about 42).

**What is good:** exact error strings and Content-Type values are asserted with `deepEqual`/`equal`, not prefixes. Boundaries are tested on both sides: 10000/10001 bytes, 80/81 UTF-16 units, emoji 40/41, 65535/65536, 2000-02-29 and 2100. Rule order is tested, including 413 before parsing and invalid end/order before 409. Byte-exact routing is tested over raw sockets, and a pipelined test checks the whole body is read before replying. Restart, save-failure and concurrency tests are strong. The page tests cover overlapping list fetches (cases a–f), whether Book is enabled before the outcome is handled, and an allow-list proxy that is shown to catch bad sources. Temp folders and child processes are always cleaned up in `finally`/`after`.

### Missing spec coverage (spec line → missing test)
1. **spec:12 "not data in the layout this server writes"** (and decisions:5/11): only a missing key and an extra key are tested. There are no cases for:
   - `nextId` ≤ the largest id, e.g. `{"nextId":1,"bookings":[{id:2,…}]}`
   - duplicate ids
   - `nextId` 0, 1.5 or `"3"`
   - a non-integer id
   - a stored booking with an invalid date or time
   - an untrimmed stored title
   - overlapping stored bookings

   A loader that accepts `nextId:1` next to id 2 hands out a duplicate id and passes every current test.
2. **spec:15 "Any other unexpected failure … 500 `internal error` … keeps running"** (decisions:3: public file read failure = 500): no test. Copy `server.mjs` into a temp folder without `public/`, then check that `GET /` and `GET /app.js` give 500 `{"error":"internal error"}` with the JSON Content-Type, and that `/api/rooms` still answers 200.
3. **spec:10 "This line is the only thing the server ever writes to stdout"**: stdout is checked only after a few successful GETs (`startup.test.mjs:96-103`). After the 500 save failures in `persistence.test.mjs:101-136`, neither stdout nor stderr is checked. A server that runs `console.log(err)` on 500 passes.
4. **spec:57 "A reply other than a 204 whose body cannot be read … counts as no reply"** for DELETE: there is no Cancel test with `resolveBadJson(404)` expecting `Could not reach the server.` and no list refetch. A version that treats this as `Request failed.` and refetches passes.
5. **spec:57 success status per method** for DELETE: nothing checks that DELETE answered with 200 (not 204) is an error status. Submit has the matching test (`page-actions.test.mjs:134`); Cancel does not.
6. **spec:9 unset `PORT` means 3000**: only `PORT=''` gets as far as listening (`startup.test.mjs:157`). Unset `PORT` is only checked on the port-in-use path.

### Quality issues
- **Silently passing tests:**
  - `startup.test.mjs:121-125`: a bare `catch { return; }` swallows every error, not just EADDRINUSE, and the test reports a pass.
  - `startup.test.mjs:156`: `if (!holder) return;` also passes silently.
  - Both should use `t.skip(...)`.
- **Weak assertion:** `request-body.test.mjs:231` is `raw.includes(ROOMS_JSON.slice(1,-1)) || raw.includes('"rooms"')`. The second half makes the first pointless. It should parse the second reply's body and `deepEqual` it to the rooms object.
- **Brittle against decisions:15:**
  - `page-actions.test.mjs:187` and `:275` only notice the list refetch when `call.options?.method === 'GET'`.
  - A valid `app.js` that calls `fetch(url)` with no options gives `seen = []`, so the test fails.
  - Both should use the existing `methodOf(call) === 'GET'`.
- **Duplication:**
  - `uniqueDate` is identical in `booking-rules.test.mjs:15-23` and `request-body.test.mjs:10-17`.
  - `withTemp` is in both `startup.test.mjs:16` and `persistence.test.mjs:12`.
  - `expectError` is repeated in `routing:31`, `booking-rules:29` and `request-body:65`.
  - `JSON_TYPE` is defined in 4 files.
  - `NO_REPLY`, `FAILED` and `methodOf` appear in both `page-load-list:5-8` and `page-actions:5-12`.
  - `page-script-api.test.mjs:73-76` (SPECS) and `:117` (flush) copy `fake-dom.mjs`.
  - The "enabled before #error is set" setter spy appears twice (`page-actions:199-213`, `:284-297`).
- **Readability:**
  - `startup.test.mjs:299-321`: passing an `undefined` status to mean "skip this call" is a hack.
  - `booking-rules.test.mjs:72,80-81`: the titles contain invisible U+3000, U+00A0 and U+FEFF characters. The "inner NBSP" case is correct, but it looks identical to the line above it.
  - `routing.test.mjs:140` ignores the POST result.

Against the stricter gate you set (overall at least 9, no item under 7), this suite fails: overall is 8 and duplication is 6.

## GRADE
Overall: 8/10
Verdict: fail
structure: 8 — helpers are well separated, but page-actions hooks depend on `options.method` and fireNonMutating uses an `undefined`-status skip hack
naming: 8 — mostly clear, with some terse names (`mk`, `B1`/`X`/`Y`, `before_`/`after_`) and invisible Unicode in fixtures
duplication: 6 — uniqueDate, withTemp, expectError, JSON_TYPE, NO_REPLY/FAILED/methodOf, SPECS/flush and the textContent spy are copied across files
size: 9 — all files ≤ 348 lines, all functions < 50 lines
errors: 7 — startup.test.mjs:123 bare catch swallows every error and the test passes; :156 is a silent return instead of t.skip
tests: 8 — exact values, both-side boundaries, near-misses killed and deterministic cleanup, but gaps in data-file validation, the 500 unexpected-failure path, stdout after errors, DELETE bad-JSON and non-204 handling, plus one OR-weakened assertion
security: 10 — no secrets; temp folders are isolated and child processes get a stripped env
leftovers: 9 — no console.log, debug code or TODOs; only invisible Unicode literals hurt readability
Fixes:
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/startup.test.mjs:255 add BAD_DATA cases: nextId ≤ max id, duplicate ids, nextId 0/1.5/"3", non-integer id, stored booking with bad date or time, untrimmed stored title, overlapping stored bookings
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/startup.test.mjs:121 catch only EADDRINUSE and call t.skip('port 65535 busy'); rethrow anything else
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/startup.test.mjs:156 replace the silent `return` with t.skip, and also run the success path with PORT unset
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/startup.test.mjs:299 pass an explicit call list instead of skipping calls whose status is `undefined`
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/persistence.test.mjs:136 after the 500s, assert stdout is exactly the listening line and stderr is empty or as expected
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/persistence.test.mjs:137 add a test with server.mjs copied to a temp folder without public/: GET / and /app.js give 500 {"error":"internal error"} with the JSON type, and the server keeps serving /api/rooms
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/request-body.test.mjs:231 parse the second reply's body and deepEqual it to the rooms object; drop the `|| raw.includes('"rooms"')`
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/page-actions.test.mjs:187 use methodOf(call) === 'GET' (decisions:15 allows fetch without options)
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/page-actions.test.mjs:275 use methodOf(call) === 'GET'
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/page-actions.test.mjs:269 add Cancel tests: resolveBadJson(404) gives "Could not reach the server." with no refetch; DELETE with 200 gives "Request failed." and refetches
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/booking-rules.test.mjs:15 move uniqueDate into helpers/server.mjs and delete the copy at request-body.test.mjs:10
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/startup.test.mjs:16 move withTemp, JSON_TYPE and expectError into helpers/server.mjs; remove the copies at persistence.test.mjs:12, routing.test.mjs:31, request-body.test.mjs:65 and booking-rules.test.mjs:29
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/page-actions.test.mjs:5 share NO_REPLY, FAILED, methodOf and the textContent setter spy (lines 199 and 284) with page-load-list.test.mjs:5 through one helper module
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/page-script-api.test.mjs:73 reuse SPECS and flush from fake-dom.mjs (export them) instead of copying
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/booking-rules.test.mjs:80 write invisible characters as \u3000, \u00a0 and \ufeff escapes (also line 72)
- /root/bench-runs/h4-ec2b7dbc/test/routing.test.mjs:140 assert the POST's status or remove the call
